from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_color = 2
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider_color).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider_color for r in range(h))]
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == divider_color for c in range(w))]
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (background, divider_color)]
    if not cells:
        return out
    if horizontal:
        divider = horizontal[0]
        min_r = min(r for r, c, v in cells)
        max_r = max(r for r, c, v in cells)
        shift = (divider + 1 - min_r) if min_r > divider else (divider - 1 - max_r)
        for r, c, v in cells:
            out[r][c] = background
        moved = [(r + shift, c, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        for r, c, v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        stripe = max(r for r, c, v in moved) + 1 if shift < 0 or min_r > divider else min(r for r, c, v in moved) - 1
        for c in range(w):
            out[stripe][c] = 8
    elif vertical:
        divider = vertical[0]
        min_c = min(c for r, c, v in cells)
        max_c = max(c for r, c, v in cells)
        shift = (divider + 1 - min_c) if min_c > divider else (divider - 1 - max_c)
        for r, c, v in cells:
            out[r][c] = background
        moved = [(r, c + shift, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        for r, c, v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        stripe = max(c for r, c, v in moved) + 1 if min_c > divider else min(c for r, c, v in moved) - 1
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
